name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key. Created by AI under the directions of the maintainer.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.243: The status line under the worker list now says what does not run by itself - as
    words, not as a greyed lamp. "download off" and "upload off" mean the direction cannot start at
    all (switch, no library, no target language, no credentials); "download manual", "upload manual",
    "upload postprocessing manual", "database refresh manual" and "oshash refresh manual" mean it can
    start but nothing starts it by itself. OnArrival is an automatism and carries no word at all. The
    notes ride on the line that already reports a pending fire, from the same answer, so the two cannot
    disagree. Lamps, stored results and pending fires are untouched, so a run never disappears behind a
    switch.
